The covariate file also has two columns: SCAIP1-6 and SCAIP7-18. Samples from these batches (scALOFT samples) are annotated as 1 in these two columns. You need this info to make sure you grab the correct wave of the covariate file for the analysis.

SCAIP1 - SCAIP5V2 is Chemistry V2
SCAIP5V3 - SCAIP18 is Chemistry V3

#need to be on node to run

method="fastdemux"
#merging seurat objects, removing duplicate samples, removing V2 chemistry, removing low cell count, removing unmatched combinations
Rscript src/merge_filter_initSeurat.R $analysis $method $sample_batch_assignments


#split this from the cellranger script since dims and resolution need to be chosen and entered
#VERY memory intensive
project=ALL #this refers to if running part of a batch or all samples. previous scripts grab this from the samples object
Rscript src/2b_seuratPCA.R $analysis $project $method

#look at PCA and elbowplot to pick dimensions. resolution will need to be set but will need to check umaps to do that in 2c
Rscript src/2c_seuratumap.R $analysis 13 $project $method

#look at umap cluster labels to select resolution
for res in 0.1 0.15 0.2 0.3 0.4 0.5; do
echo running $res
Rscript src/2d_seuratclustering.R $analysis $project $method $res
done

#run also preharmony to see if effects are removed by harmony
Rscript src/2e_seuratpreharmony_umap.R $analysis $project $method 11
#for res in 0.1 0.15 0.2 0.3 0.4 0.5; do #start with res matching harmony
